sectors.name: Technology
themes: Indonesia's accelerating internet penetration and government-backed digitalization initiatives are structurally lifting domestic tech names like INET and YELO, independent of US tech volatility.
Local tech valuations remain supported by a young, mobile-first population and rising e-commerce adoption, creating durable revenue growth for ID-listed players.
US tech names face persistent headwinds from higher-for-longer rates and AI capex digestion, making them structurally less attractive for Indonesia-focused portfolios seeking stable alpha.
sectors.ai: Buy INET and YELO on continued domestic digital-infrastructure demand, but trim exposure to US-listed tech names like GDDY and INTU as rate-sensitive multiples compress. Rotate into WIFI and VTNY for near-term momentum, while holding CENT and IRSX as defensive plays. Watch for a sector pullback below -2% to add aggressively.

sectors.name: Mining & Energy
themes: Indonesia's coal price floor via DMO and HBA benchmark keeps thermal coal producers' margins structurally protected, supporting BYAN and INDY despite global volatility.
Nickel downstreaming and smelter build-out in Sulawesi/Halmahera create recurring infrastructure demand, benefiting ALKA and MYOH as long-term volume plays.
US LNG and gas infrastructure capex (TRGP) signals sustained global energy demand, reinforcing Indonesian export competitiveness and pricing power for coal and gas-linked equities.
sectors.ai: Buy pullbacks in high-quality thermal coal exporters (BYAN, INDY) and nickel/energy infrastructure names (ALKA, MYOH) as Indonesia's domestic demand and export pricing hold firm; the WATCH signal suggests adding on dips below 5% rather than chasing. Rotate out of laggards with weak cash conversion, and use US energy strength (TRGP) as a confirmation of global commodity resilience.

sectors.name: Infrastructure
themes: Domestic toll road and port operators are outperforming as Indonesia's logistics corridor expansion accelerates, driven by new capital projects and rising inter-island trade volumes.
Digital infrastructure names like LINK and EXCL benefit from structural data center and 5G rollout demand, with tower leasing rates and fiber penetration still below regional peers.
US-linked infrastructure plays face headwinds from higher-for-longer rates, making local-currency, government-backed projects the preferred risk-adjusted exposure.
sectors.ai: Buy pullbacks in TEBE and YPAS after their limit-up moves, as both signal sustained domestic momentum in toll and port logistics. Rotate out of US-exposed names like PACK and ASLI, which lag on Fed uncertainty. Favor LINK for digital infrastructure upside, and accumulate EXCL on telecom tower re-rating.

sectors.name: Logistics
themes: Indonesia's inter-island trade and commodity logistics demand remain structurally insulated from US slowdowns, supporting sustained domestic volume growth for port and shipping operators.
Consolidation in port and warehouse assets, plus tariff adjustments, is driving margin expansion for mid-cap logistics names like KJEN and SOCI, a durable earnings driver.
Government infrastructure spending on ports and toll roads continues to lower distribution costs, structurally improving profitability for integrated logistics players over multi-year horizons.
sectors.ai: Buy logistics selectively on domestic volume recovery, not broad beta: KJEN, PORT, and SOCI lead on port/warehouse throughput and tariff repricing, while TMAS and RMKE offer coastal bulk upside. Trim US-exposed names if global trade slows; hold core positions through Q3 as IDX logistics outperformance persists on resilient inter-island demand.

sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Regulatory clarity in Indonesia (Bappebti licensing) is the durable driver for compliant exchange listings and institutional custody flows.
Layer-2 scaling and zero-knowledge proofs (POL, MATIC) structurally reduce transaction costs, boosting on-chain adoption in emerging markets.
Stablecoin infrastructure (STABLE, SKY) is becoming the settlement layer for cross-border remittances, a key Indonesia corridor.
sectors.ai: Rotate into high-beta liquid alts (VVV, HASH) for momentum, but cap exposure at 5% of the crypto sleeve given flat aggregate and no regional catalyst. Use POL/MATIC dips to accumulate for staking yield; avoid chasing STABLE/SKY until volume confirms. Hedge with AAVE as lending-rate proxy.
